description: A Model Weather picture's value at a point, from the four pixels flow_cell gives (each its red, green and alpha bytes): read between them linearly, as weatherlayers-gl's LINEAR reading does, each byte a 255th of `unscale` [least, most] a step. For the wind (`vector`) its east part in red and north part in green are each read so, and its speed and the direction it blows from (degrees true) come from those parts, the vector average, so the same point reads the same wind on every app. A wind under 1 kt is calm (`calm` true, `from_deg` null): FMH-1 (FCM-H1-2019) Table 5-1 gives under a knot as "Calm; smoke rises vertically", reported as calm with no direction, 00000KT (5.5.2, 12.6.5 d), so the apps write "Calm" rather than a direction the picture's rounding made up. `calm` is false for a scalar field. Null where a pixel the point is read from has no value (alpha 0).

pixels.description: Four pixels, as flow_cell orders them, each [red, green, alpha] bytes.

calm.description: A wind under 1 kt, which has no direction (FMH-1 Table 5-1, 5.5.2); false for a scalar.
